scope: Public reproducible response-shape/task-relevance preflight for canonical SECURITY_REVIEW_GENERAL code-diff review, NOT evaluator adapter, semantic accuracy classifier, reranking or live routing improvement.

canonical_same_intent.observed: 100-entry unrelated general GitHub Security Advisories feed

direct_different_envelope.observed: two source-related heuristic rule identifiers; not same canonical routed request envelope

routed_other_intent.observed: code-target-specific review but different evaluated Intent

comparison_policy: Only same canonical SECURITY_REVIEW_GENERAL target, same exact request hash, same request schema and comparable output contract may be considered for relative miner-quality comparisons. Do not rank direct/different-Intent captures as equal candidates, even when diff hashes match.
normative_input_protocol: A canonical SECURITY_REVIEW_GENERAL request must contain params.target with bounded Git unified diff. Treat other envelopes and Intents as noncomparable, not as comparable rank differences.
minimum_original_diagnostic: The one original canonical same-Intent real paid response that is a 100-item broad GHSA listing, unrelated to the input diff, must fail task relevance even when paid:true and status 200.
adversarial_controls: Reject source-blind HTTP200/paid flag as proxy for task relevance
Generic 100-GHSA feed must remain off-target if padded with fake target keywords
Wrong Intent must not become a same-Intent ranking comparison
Direct family envelope is not automatically canonical SECURITY_REVIEW_GENERAL
Echoing exact diff text without findings must not imply substantive review
Response that mentions actual source line is only structured candidate, not expert correctness
Attackers cannot inject arbitrary local files or shell through source path
Original source blob must be Git SHA1 verified before evidence is admitted
No raw third-party request or response body to be republished in evidence index
No accepted mineable scoring package or registered onchain evaluator claim
baseline_stated: HTTP 200 or payment.success:true is a false-positive task-completion baseline on original canonical PR Guard capture.
success_definition: At least one authentic published paid canonical same-Intent off-target response rejected, non-comparable external responses excluded, adversarial mutation suite passes, and claims remain limited to structural relevance.
